item.title: KUCCPS Releases List of Universities and Colleges Eligible for HELB
item.description: Students who seek to apply for placement have been advised to carefully review the eligibility status of their preferred universities and colleges before making their choices.

item.title: KWS Reveals The Truth Behind Mt Longonot's Volcanic Eruption
item.description: The mountain, inside Kenya's Great Rift Valley, showed minor seismic activity in 2007-2008 and 2013, but these were not full eruptions requiring evacuation.

item.title: Ruto’s Lawyer Among 15 Nominees for Court of Appeal Judge Positions
item.description: The Judiciary is in the process of forwarding the names of successful nominees to President William Ruto for formal appointment.

item.title: Residents Demand Compensation Over KSh3.1 Trillion Govt Project
item.description: Families displaced by project activities say they have waited for years without payment, while access to some parcels of land remains restricted.

item.title: How to File Your Taxes via WhatsApp Using KRA’s New Digital Service
item.description: The process was designed to enhance efficiency by ensuring easier access to KRA services without requiring physical visits to its offices.

item.description: Videos and images shared online showed crowds gathering at the scene as the blaze escalated, with some people attempting to salvage belongings.

item.title: Families Of Fallen Heroes Scammed in Insurance Money
item.description: Kenya Police officers serve under the National Police Service Act as constitutional officers, making them entitled to government insurance benefits like other public servants.

item.title: Journalists Abruptly Cancel Rigathi Gachagua Roundtable Interview
item.description: The interview had been scheduled to take place on Thursday evening from 7 pm to 9 pm; however, only a handful of journalists attended the panel interview.

item.title: UDA Sets Mandatory Fees for 2027 Aspirants
item.description: The party has made it clear that all these fees are non-refundable, meaning aspirants will lose their money regardless of the nomination outcome they receive.

item.title: Kenya to Connect Live With Astronauts Aboard the ISS in Historic 2026 Program
item.description: During these sessions, participants will ask questions and receive real-time responses about life aboard the ISS, ongoing scientific work, and daily routines in space.
